title: Swimcom Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swimcom:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often swimcom metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on swimcom metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how often your swimcom metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
